_comment: Profile registry for the autonomous multi-agent engine.
IMPORTANT - how VRAM numbers in this file should be read:
'vram_gb_claimed' is the figure quoted in F:/KyThuatNenAIMoi/BRAIN.md.
It is NOT trusted at runtime. local_llm_client.py stats the real GGUF on
disk and recomputes the budget via estimate_vram_gb(). If the recomputed
value disagrees with vram_gb_claimed by more than tolerance_gb, the client
emits a warning naming both numbers.
Reason this matters: BRAIN.md section 2 lists Qwen3.8-27B IQ2_XXS at
7.27 GB on disk, but the file actually present on this machine is
~8.39 GB. Trusting the document would understate Profile S VRAM by more
than a gigabyte. Measured file size always wins.
Only ONE profile is resident at a time. 16 GB of VRAM cannot hold two of
these simultaneously. Agent roles are personas multiplexed over the single
resident model - see architecture_plan.md section 4.

budget.cuda_overhead_note: BRAIN.md section 7 item 2 flags this as an ESTIMATED constant, not a measurement. Calibrate against nvidia-smi with the server running, then update here.

_comment: Named memory envelopes. `budget` above stays the default so existing
callers are unaffected; core/memory_governor.py selects one of these by
name and every plan it prints says which envelope it was measured against.
TIGHT is the operator-chosen target as of 2026-09-04: keep the GGUF that is
already on disk and spend the headroom on KV slots for batched deliberation.
The 7.8 GB target in the original directive is kept as ULTRA and is marked
unreachable for this file - see its note. That is arithmetic, not opinion:
8.39 (weights) + 0.55 (CUDA) = 8.94 GB before a single KV token exists.

STANDARD.note: The shipped envelope. Sentry RiskGuard defaults to these.

TIGHT.note: Active target. Fits Qwen3.8-27B IQ2_XXS as measured on this disk plus 6 KV slots at 4096 for batched deliberation. The 4.0 GB host ceiling holds only with mmap enabled - --no-mmap copies the whole 8.39 GB into host RAM and breaks it instantly.

ULTRA.note: UNREACHABLE with the GGUF currently on disk. 8.39 + 0.55 = 8.94 GB at zero context. Needs Qwen3.8-27B IQ1_M (6.73 GB) or IQ1_S (6.19 GB), neither of which is downloaded. memory_governor reports the shortfall rather than silently degrading.

_comment: Draft models for speculative decoding. A draft model costs VRAM twice:
its own weights and its own KV cache, and both come out of the same
ceiling as the target model. core/inference_planner.py counts both.

qwen2.5-0.5b-q4km.label: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M
qwen2.5-0.5b-q4km.kv_note: 24 layers x 2 KV heads x 64 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 12 KiB/token at f16. Derived from the published Qwen2.5-0.5B config, NOT measured from the GGUF header - verify with tools/gguf_budget.py before quoting.
qwen2.5-0.5b-q4km.source: F:/KyThuatNenAIMoi/TAI_DRAFT_MODEL.bat downloads this from Hugging Face.
qwen2.5-0.5b-q4km.vocab_note: UNVERIFIED. Speculative decoding requires the draft and target to share a tokenizer vocabulary. Qwen2.5 and Qwen3.x are different generations; llama-server refuses mismatched vocabularies at load. Confirm before relying on this entry.

S.label: SPEED / low-VRAM worker
S.mtp_note: Disabled deliberately. BRAIN.md QD-3: at 2-3 bit quantization MTP makes generation SLOWER, not faster.
S.confidence_note: BRAIN.md section 7 item 1 lists this ~52 tok/s as unverified, extrapolated from eta=0.852 which was calibrated on IQ3_XXS. Do not quote as fact. Measure with tools/probe_tokps.py.

Q.label: QUALITY / high-reasoning coordinator
Q.confidence_note: BRAIN.md section 3: 35 tok/s without MTP, 50-55 with draft-mtp n=3, on this exact card.
Q.reasoning_effort_note: BRAIN.md QD-4: default xhigh burned 22276 reasoning tokens on one SVG task (~7 min). Forcing medium is a bigger latency lever than MTP.

T.label: TURBO MoE / fast subagent routing
T.context_note: Deliberately 32768, not the 327680 used in the BRAIN.md benchmark run. BRAIN.md QD-2 lists reducing context as one of three untried levers toward 100 tok/s, and a 327K KV cache is unaffordable alongside anything else.
T.confidence_note: CRITICAL: the 87.4-95.9 tok/s in BRAIN.md was measured on IQ2_M at ctx 327680 via Vulkan with ngram-mod. The file on this disk is IQ1_M, a DIFFERENT and lower quant tier that appears nowhere in the BRAIN.md benchmark table. The directive attributed those numbers to Q2_K_XL, a third quant. Three distinct quants, one set of numbers - none of them this file. Treat 1-bit output quality as unproven for coordinator work.

default_profile_note: S is default here ONLY because it is the profile whose weights are confirmed present and it leaves headroom. Note this CONTRADICTS BRAIN.md QD-1, which calls Profile S 'gan nhu vo dung' on this card (same throughput as Q, one quant tier worse, 11.5x less context). Switch to Q as soon as IQ3_XXS is downloaded.

server.n_threads_note: Directive caps worker threads at 8 of the 12 available on the i5-12400F, leaving headroom for OS and IDE.

fallback.note: Opt-in only. Disabled by default so a local-only run can never silently egress prompt content to a paid remote API. Enable explicitly in code or via ENGINE_ALLOW_FALLBACK=1.
